name: 山东达驰电气有限公司 (Shandong Dachi Electric Co., Ltd.)

structural_breaks.note: Ownership change: 青岛海信网络能源股份有限公司 (Hisense Network Energy, a Hisense Group company) acquiring 65% of 山东达驰电气有限公司 and two sister companies (水发驰翔, 达驰高压开关) from 水发集团/山东水发电力集团 (Shandong provincial SOE). Merger-control simple-case publicity: “青岛海信网络能源股份有限公司收购山东达驰电气有限公司等三家公司股权案”, publicity period 2026-04-03 to 2026-04-12 (Shanghai AMR, SAMR-delegated; read via a sina.com.cn mirror because the regulator page was not fetched). Completion on 2026-04-22 via 山东产权交易中心 (total ≈CNY 857m) is reported only in press coverage — NOT verified from a primary document. Before this, the company website describes Dachi as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Shandong Shuifa Electric Power Group.

profile.listing_check: Not listed: no stock code or exchange appears on the official company site; Unified Social Credit Code 91371700720758629B (limited-liability company, 有限公司). No cninfo/SSE/SZSE/HKEX filer found under this name. Revenue is not published (company site gives total assets CNY 730m and R&D ≈4% of sales only).
profile.products: Per company site (EN about page): 750kV-and-below intelligent oil-immersed power transformers up to 1,500 MVA (1.5 million kVA); S11–S22 energy-saving distribution transformers; SH15 amorphous-core transformers; ≤35kV dry-type power transformers; high-overload distribution transformers; box-type energy-saving substations; inverter storage/booster units and box inverter-booster units (PV/storage); HV gas-insulated combined apparatus (GIS). Annual capacity 80 million kVA. Test/manufacturing equipment from Germany (GEORG core cutting), Finland, US; epoxy vacuum casting.
